_sources.orbit: Osculating elements from the JPL Small-Body Database (src/data/generated/small-bodies.json, 1P/Halley).
_sources.nucleus: Nucleus ~15 x 8 km (Giotto/Vega; JPL SBDB extent 14.9 x 8.2 km), very dark (albedo ~0.04). Its spin is complex (~2.2 d and ~7.4 d periods); a simple 52.8 h rotation is used (approximation).
